Case-analysis puzzle (5 speakers) *

Amy says: “Dale is telling the truth only if Cara is telling the truth”
Ben says: “Eve is lying or Ben is telling the truth”

Eve says: “at least one of Ben and Eve is telling the truth”
Constraint: at least 2 of the statements are false. (Speakers marked * are not bound to be truthful or lying — each may tell the truth or lie.) Which of the following must be true?
options: Ben must be telling the truth, regardless of which consistent case occurs.
Cara may be lying in some consistent cases but not in others.
Dale may be lying in some consistent cases but not in others.

Cara must be lying, regardless of which consistent case occurs.
